calls.title: Gdna-Growthbook-kickoff
calls.summary: The team convened to strategize the deployment of the FTR process on the production AWS account using Monte Cloud, with Anvitha leading the onboarding over the next two weeks. A critical 24-hour scan will identify high and medium risks, guiding necessary remediations for FTR approval. Jeremy Dorn emphasized his preference to join onboarding calls to ensure permissions and role creation are appropriately managed. The onboarding will involve establishing a read-only IAM role and enabling Security Hub for CIS compliance reporting without altering account settings. Concerns about overly broad permissions were raised, particularly regarding EC2 instances. The team decided to utilize a dedicated Slack channel for real-time communication and set a timeline to complete onboarding within 24 hours, prioritizing scans to meet FTR submission deadlines, with Will Horn ensuring support for escalations throughout the process.
calls.keywords: FDR deployment, Monte Cloud, AWS Security Hub, IAM role permissions, Well-Architected Framework, Growthbook AWS account
calls.action_items:
**Anvitha**
Lead and coordinate the FDR deployment on AWS Batch for Growthbook (02:26)
Proceed with onboarding Growthbook’s AWS production account to Monte Cloud and guide the team through the process if needed (07:20)
Add Growthbook team members as users on the Monte Cloud tenant and provide login credentials (08:48)
Share instructions on onboarding the AWS account to Monte Cloud for team to verify role deployments and permissions (14:51)
Enable Security Hub on Growthbook’s AWS production account to collect the CIS report required for FTR submission (32:20)
Schedule and coordinate a follow-up meeting midweek next week to assess onboarding progress and next steps (33:45)

**Jeremy Dorn**
Login and onboard Growthbook’s AWS production account to Monte Cloud tenant; verify IAM role permissions in detail (11:57)
Review IAM role permissions deployed by Monte Cloud and identify objectionable permissions (specifically EC2 stop permissions and SSM parameter update permissions) (20:20)
Provide specific feedback on required permission modifications to GDNA/Monte Cloud to ensure least privilege principle is maintained (25:43)

**Will Horn**
Introduce the GDNA role and partnership context; provide availability for technical escalation as needed (06:00)
Liaise with Monte Cloud technical contact (Eric) regarding the concerns raised about IAM role permissions and request a custom role document or adjustments (24:35)
Coordinate with the Growthbook and Monte Cloud teams to ensure safe onboarding and remediation of IAM permissions based on feedback (26:50)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Participate actively in the onboarding process and discuss timing and practical next steps on the call (05:33)
Provide operational context and raise Marketplace account vs. production account clarification questions (11:57)
